generator: scripts/turbopack-gym/drift.mjs (bench.mjs builds: next build --experimental-build-mode=compile, cpuset-pinned systemd scope, one at a time)
bindingBuild: next-napi-bindings from vercel/next.js v16.4.0 (gym/base) plus each binding's patches; cargo --release, CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=false, CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_CODEGEN_UNITS=16

method.warm: the pristine tree's cold build output directory (with <distDir>/cache) restored, then a build of the edited tree into it, cache on
method.cold: a fresh output directory, cache on (the cache starts empty and is written)
method.off: a fresh output directory, Turbopack's persistent cache off (experimental.turbopackFileSystemCacheForBuild false)
method.env: TURBO_ENGINE_IGNORE_DIRTY=1 for every build: patched bindings are built from a modified tree, and Turbopack otherwise keeps a dirty build's cache in a directory it deletes on the next build

edits.label: N feature modules each get "-drift" appended to their first table label (output changes, module graph shape does not)
edits.import: label, plus a new import of a util the module did not import, used by a new export (one new module graph edge per edited module)
edits.order: pick k is feature k mod F, module slot (floor(k/F)*7 + k mod F) mod M (F = 420, M = 29)

method.order: per rep, points ascending; within a point every binding x mode, rotated one place per point
method.cacheSize: du -sb of <distDir>/cache before and after the build
method.split: startup = run-turbopack's start offset; preEmit = emit start - run-turbopack start; afterCompile = wall - run-turbopack end; lowCoreS = whole seconds inside run-turbopack using under 1.5 cores (the scope's cpu.stat), leadLowCoreS = those from its start before the first busier second. A warm build emits no module-graph or write-entrypoints span for its recomputation, so its graph/entrypoints fields are null
